LIST i, a FROM Legality [has LegalityFormat: 'commander'] has LegalityStatus: 'Legal' AND ALSO has Card has CardId i AND ALSO has Card OPTIONALLY has CardArtist a BUT NOT has Card has CardPower <> '*'

note: Unanswerable against this model: the schema has no fact type connecting Card to Set. Card only has the denormalized value CardSetCode (a plain value type), and Set is only reachable from SetTranslation ('SetTranslation has Set'); there is no CardHasSet / SetHasCard reading either direction ('is of' from Card does not reach Set; 'is of' from Set only reaches SetTranslation). So a card's set entity (and hence SetIsForeignOnly) cannot be walked as a role path.
